data.name: Unblock_PageFileText
data.value: Removes the page file from {0}: (takes effect after a reboot). If another internal NTFS drive has at least 8 GB free, a system-managed page file is set up there in the meantime; otherwise the computer runs without a page file until you restore, and very heavy memory use could make programs close. Restart, run the shrink, then restore the previous setting; Windows Partition Manager remembers it.
